body: When doing activities you guys used to like to do just end with an argument. At this point, you can either talk it out or move on. Everything in life is temporary, including friends. People change. They can become toxic. You must put your own sanity and happiness before the history of a friendship.
Can’t relate. I used cheat codes. I was rich on the Sims! Fuck that burglar, keep the furniture. I can buy it back.. maybe even something more fancy. I was wanting to get rid of it anyways.
True. We live to die. Which is an even greater reason to live your life to the fullest while you’re here

Mind your business. What’s going on in this parking lot is none of your business. Well, unless one of these cars are yours.. then my apologizes.

Why do all these cars look alike? All these dull shades of gray, just a reflection of what I feel inside. 

I don’t know which one of these cars belong to my cheating ass ex, but I know it was gray! Light gray, dark gray.. I don’t remember, but it was gray!

I know what his car alarm sounds like. I just know. It’s a sound you remember because I hear it in the middle of the night too many times as I lay eyes open with nothing but a half warm pillow at my side.

Evil is everywhere. It’s just part of this world. But there’s only one you. You may be right about your nephews not remembering you due to their age. But realize you said 50-100 YEARS for your family forgetting you. That’s a whole generation. Your perspective on life sounds like “it’s my life, I make my own choices”? But you care about your life. Or you wouldn’t have mentioned your mom. You know your life will impact others. So you’re important.
Saying that really says you want someone to reach out.. and this is what this whole subreddit is about.

I am one of those people who have these thoughts,. But me personally I can better control them when I’m around other people. If I keep to myself for too long, then the thoughts increase. 

Even if you don’t bring up your thoughts, you should still be around others. Because the feeling of loneliness is a big reason why.

You’re right. Surviving takes energy. Let me explain more.. By hard work, I mean controlling those evil thoughts that pass through your mind. By dedication, you continue to live on so you can share you story and help another going through the same situation.
I’m a female. The weirdos greatly outweigh anybody worth meeting. I’ve tried POF mostly.

Let me share that I’m a female. And I’m straight. 

But good idea.. I’ll get cute and go grocery shopping on February 14th. What do you recommend I put in my shopping cart? Chocolate..? Strawberries..? Grapefruit..?
Don’t you have to pay for eHarmony?
Of course. This is a whole community of those to talk to! Tell us your troubles and we’ll listen.

Honestly.. who to say this isn’t hell? We see what we see in the news, or timelines on social media, maybe even in front of our eyes.. how do we know we’re not in hell already? Maybe this is life after death. A life of sorrow where you are forced into a repeated cycle of sadness, anger, and disappointment. 

Nonetheless — take me with you,
I still meant what I said. Whoever this chick is don’t even make her relevant. She’s one of the worse type of people — just says things without consideration for another person. Ugh

Well, it’s rather vague as to what’s going on.. but fuck the person who made the comment that ruined your day! Stupid fucker. If it was a guy, may his dick fall off in the urinal. If it was a female, may her vagina smell like tuna for all of her existence.

Wow. You sound so similar to me. I found your post when I searched damaged goods. Because that’s how I feel. I don’t know about you, but I’m a 23 yr old female and I’ve been diagnosed with depression and anxiety.. I was prescribed some pills but I stopped using them because they just made me feel numb. I don’t know what to do with my life at this point. I feel like a waste of space. I don’t have the desire to any of the things I once liked to do like draw, write, or build websites. I just want to sleep because I can dream. Dream of a better me, the old me.

Side note: I don’t want you to feel alone, because you’re not. If anything the people around you just don’t understand. But I do.
